title: Take the Rook, Keep the Check
setup: Black's king has wandered to b5, its rook sits on b8 and a passed pawn is one square from queening on d2.
hint: You have no time to stop the pawn. Find the capture that also opens a line at the king.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxb8+}} wins a rook with check, and from there {{Qd6+}} and {{Qd4#}} drive the king down the board. The d2 pawn never gets to move, which is the only defense against it that matters.
